summary.text: Nadarius E. Clark is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates, representing the 84th District, which covers part of Chesapeake, part of Isle of Wight County, the city of Franklin and part of the city of Suffolk, and has served since January 10, 2024, with an earlier tenure listed as 2022 to March 17, 2023.
Clark sits on the House committees on Agriculture, Chesapeake and Natural Resources; Public Safety; Education; and Labor and Commerce.

paragraphs.text: Nadarius E. Clark was born in Norfolk, VA, according to the House profile.
The profile lists Clark's education as I. C. Norcom High School (advanced diploma, 2013) and Virginia Union University (BFA, Music and Theatre, 2019).
The profile gives Clark's occupation as mental health counselor / political consultant.

Clark's listed memberships and affiliations include Virginia Union University National Alumni Association; NAACP; Alpha Phi Omega National Service Fraternity, Inc.; Zion Community Church - Northern Suffolk.
